markscheme: **C.** Cl• has an unpaired electron (7 valence electrons). Cl⁻, Cl⁺ and Cl₂ have all electrons paired.

prompt: Write an equation for the homolytic fission of chlorine and state the condition required.
markscheme: Cl₂ → 2Cl• (each atom takes one electron of the shared pair) **(A1)**; UV light **(A1)**

prompt: Outline the mechanism for the reaction of methane with chlorine in UV light, and explain why a mixture of products forms.
markscheme:
Initiation: Cl₂ → 2Cl• **(A1)**

Propagation: CH₄ + Cl• → CH₃• + HCl; CH₃• + Cl₂ → CH₃Cl + Cl• **(A1)**

Termination: e.g. Cl• + Cl• → Cl₂; CH₃• + CH₃• → C₂H₆ **(A1)**

Cl• can also attack CH₃Cl and further products, giving CH₂Cl₂, CHCl₃, CCl₄ and ethane **(R1)**
